newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Russell Goward arrested at Hare Krishna farm.
newsitem.headline: Russell Goward arrested at Hare Krishna farm.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission said former high profile businessman Russell Goward would appear in court later this month following his arrest at a Hare Krishna commune in the north of New South Wales last Sunday.
Goward, who was head of the listed Westmex investment group which collapsed in 1990, was scheduled to appear in Sydney's Central Court on June 27 to answer charges of breaching his bail conditions.
He had been charged with a number of securities offences relating to the collapse of Westmex.
